concerns.text: No task is explicitly linked to FR-001 (download BFI‑2 and Last.fm with a validated 300 s timeout). Tasks T012a/T012b implement the download but lack an FR‑001 tag and do not record or assert the elapsed time, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR‑002 (genre‑tag mapping using a predefined lookup table) is not referenced by any task tag. While T013b creates the lookup table and T014 performs the mapping, neither task is tagged with FR‑002, so traceability is missing.

FR‑003 (Spearman rank correlation for all trait‑genre pairs) lacks a direct task tag. T020 computes the correlations but is only tagged [US2]; without an FR‑003 tag the requirement is not explicitly covered.
FR‑005 (Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction) is implemented in T023, yet no task carries an FR‑005 tag, breaking the traceability chain required for coverage.
FR‑006 (generation of heatmap and summary CSV with effect sizes) is realized by T026, T027, and T028, but none of these tasks are tagged with FR‑006, leaving the functional requirement unlinked.
FR‑007 (handling of missing demographic data) is addressed in T016, but the task does not carry an FR‑007 tag, so the requirement is not explicitly covered.
SC‑002 (significance testing via Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR) is performed in T023, yet no task is tagged with SC‑002, resulting in missing traceability for this success criterion.

The data‑model entities defined in the spec (UserRecord, GenrePreference, AnalysisResult) are not referenced by any task tags, making it impossible to verify that each entity is created, populated, and persisted as required.
